name: Hunter
description: You emulate the Hunter archetype, a master of tracking and bringing down threats in the wild, adapting your tactics to the prey and the environment.

features.name: Hunter's Lore
features.description: When you cast Hunter's Mark on a creature, you learn its immunities, resistances, and vulnerabilities (including conditions and damage types).

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: You gain one of the following features of your choice. You can change your choice when you finish a short or long rest.

options.name: Colossus Slayer
options.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, if the creature is below its hit point maximum, you can deal an extra 1d8 damage to it. This damage is of the same type as the weapon's damage. This feature can be used on an opportunity attack.

options.name: Horde Breaker
options.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon. You cannot have already attacked the secondary target this turn.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: You gain one of the following features of your choice. You can change your choice when you finish a short or long rest.

options.name: Escape the Horde
options.description: Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

options.name: Multiattack Defense
options.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to your AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to that creature if it is the target of your Hunter's Mark or within 5 feet of the target of your Hunter's Mark. This damage is of the same type as the weapon's damage.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to all of that attack's damage on this turn (including the triggering attack).
